nameScan.firstSentence: Iolanthe unpacked the amplifier on the workbench.

windows.text: Iolanthe unpacked the amplifier on the workbench. She had waited three weeks for the parts.
The power supply unit came first. Iolanthe checked the fuse and the mains lead before she touched anything else.
Iolanthe switched the amplifier on. She watched the valves glow and waited for the hum to settle.
In the district everyone knew Iolanthe, and nobody had a bad word for Iolanthe.
